summary: Full end-to-end test of MS Project Intelligent Import (backend + frontend). All 4 frontend flows PASS: (1) Create-new-project via /roadmap modal with plan_v1.xml, (2) Update diff screen with plan_v2.xml showing 1 new / 2 updated / 3 unchanged, (3) Idempotent re-analysis showing 'Aucun changement' with Appliquer disabled, (4) ProjectDetail 'Import MSP' button with window.confirm + alert flow. Backend endpoints (import-new, analyze idempotent, analyze v2, apply upsert) all re-verified via curl and match expected counts. Export MS Project XML regression OK (valid MSPDI XML returned). Test project cleaned up (DELETE 204).

minor.issue: HEAD request returns 405 (only GET allowed) — cosmetic; GET works and returns valid MSPDI XML. Not a functional bug.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx is a very large file (>1000 lines) — consider splitting into subcomponents (already flagged in prior iterations).

MsProjectImport apply flow reads d.tasks_created + d.milestones_created but toast content is not tested against a specific selector; consider adding data-testid on the sonner toast body for future automated assertions.

handleMsProjectImport on ProjectDetail uses native window.confirm/alert while the /roadmap modal uses a proper wizard UI — inconsistent UX; recommend unifying with the modal component for a better experience.
seed_data_creation: Created one test project 'Plan Test MARCEL' (project_id b5968eb4-...) via /api/msproject/import-new, then DELETED after tests (HTTP 204). No residual test data in Altair tenant.
